test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He ordered his soldiers to take that bird away. Its gilded cage reminded him of his father whom he had imprisoned.

options.text: He said to his soldiers, "Take the bird away. Its gilded cage reminded him of his father whom I imprison."
He said to his soldiers, "Take this bird away. Its gilded cage reminds me of my father whom I imprisoned"
He said to his soldiers, "Take this bird away. Its gilded cage reminded me of my father whom I imprison."
He said to his soldiers, "May this bird be taken away. Its gilded cage reminds me of my father whom I imprisoned."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He ordered his soldiers to take that bird away. Its gilded cage reminded him of his father whom he had imprisoned.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"He ordered his soldiers to take that bird away" becomes "He said to his soldiers, 'Take this bird away.'"**
 
 
• Directly converts the command to direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "that" is changed to "this" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"Its gilded cage reminded him of his father whom he had imprisoned" becomes "Its gilded cage reminds me of my father whom I imprisoned"**
 
 
• Possessive pronoun "his" is converted to "my".
 
• Verb tense "reminded" is changed to "reminds" to match the present tense in direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Take" and ends with a period "."
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said to his soldiers, 'Take this bird away. Its gilded cage reminds me of my father whom I imprisoned.'"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said to his soldiers, 'Take the bird away. Its gilded cage reminded him of his father whom I imprison.'" 

 
 
• Incorrect tense usage and pronoun mismatch.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said to his soldiers, 'Take this bird away. Its gilded cage reminded me of my father whom I imprison.'" 
 
 
• Incorrect tense usage with "reminded" and pronoun mismatch.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said to his soldiers, 'May this bird be taken away. Its gilded cage reminds me of my father whom I imprisoned.'" 
 
 
• Incorrect command format.
